# Flix integration matrix

What this plugin registers, and which module registers it. Generated from
[`flix-integration.yaml`](../flix-integration.yaml).
`./gradlew checkIntegrationGlue`, which runs as part of `check`, fails the build if
the committed descriptors and this contract disagree in either direction.

## Language

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `Flix` |
| LSP `languageId` | `flix` |
| Extension | `.flix` |
| Implementation | `org.flixlang.intellij.lang.FlixLanguage` |

Exactly one, per [ADR 0001](adr/0001-single-language-owner.md).

No class may appear twice. One registration in two modules means the extension
runs twice — which is how the gutter arrow once appeared in duplicate.

## Debugging

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Backend | `intellijJvm` — IntelliJ's own JVM debugger |
| SMAP stratum | `Flix` |
| Sets VM default stratum | `false` |
| Claimed extensions | `.flix` |

Per [ADR 0002](adr/0002-native-jvm-debugger.md), exactly one debugger owns the
debuggee. `setDefaultStratum` is process-global and would corrupt every other
language's position manager, so it is both declared false and grepped for.

## Language server

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Server ID | `flixLanguageServer` |
| Mapping | `language` |

LSP4IJ registers these features only for `TEXT` and `textmate`. Owning a real
language silently takes them away, so the ones still wanted are re-registered
against Flix. A per-feature judgement, not a blanket copy:

| Extension point | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| `com.intellij.codeBlockProvider` | `com.redhat.devtools.lsp4ij.features.codeBlockProvider.LSPCodeBlockProvider` |
| `com.intellij.codeInsight.parameterInfo` | `com.redhat.devtools.lsp4ij.features.signatureHelp.LSPParameterInfoHandler` |
| `com.intellij.lang.psiStructureViewFactory` | `com.redhat.devtools.lsp4ij.features.documentSymbol.LSPDocumentSymbolStructureViewFactory` |

## Excluded

Registrations that must not come back. Each was removed for a stated reason, and
`checkIntegrationGlue` fails if one reappears:

- `lsp4ij.debugAdapterServer`
- `lsp4ij.dapFileNamePatternMapping`
- `textMate`
- `nativeLsp`
